title: OA TABLE 70 - the martial arts special maneuvers: the nine method columns of ranked maneuvers with their hard, soft and hard/soft form tags
audit_comment: OA round seventy-nine (capture p. 227): Table 70 - the martial arts special maneuvers grid, the thirty-six ranked maneuvers across the nine method columns with the hard, soft and hard/soft form tags, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA TABLE 70, printed capture p. 227 - the martial arts special maneuvers round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE GRID: thirty-six maneuvers across the nine method columns - 1 Kick (Circle Kick 1, Flying Kick 2, Backward Kick 3), 2 Movement the seven-deep column (Feint 1, Prone Fighting 2, Immovability 3, Missile Deflection 4, Leap 5, Speed 6, Slow Resistance 7), 3 Strike (Iron Fist 1, Crushing Blow 2, Eagle Claw 3), 4 Weapon (Weapon Catch 1, Weapon Breaker 2, Steel Cloth 3), 5 Lock (Choke Hold 1, Locking Block 2, Incapacitator 3, Immobilizing 4), 6 Throw (Fall 1, Instant Stand 2, Hurl 3, Great Throw 4), 7 Mental and Physical Training (Meditation 1, All-Around Sight 2, Mental Resistance 3, Blind Fighting 4, Ironskin 5, Levitation 6), 8 Push (Concentrated Push 1, Sticking Touch 2, One Finger 3), 9 Vital Area (Pain Touch 1, Stunning Touch 2, Paralyzing Touch 3). THE FORM TAGS coded 0 hard, 1 soft, 2 hard/soft - the general classification of the fighting style, crossover allowed; the all-soft columns Push and Vital Area; the Strike column all hard; the Movement column all soft but Speed and Slow Resistance the hard/soft. THE RANKING: the lower number the easier to learn and execute, the progression from 1 on up, more than one maneuver allowed at the same difficulty - the printed Circle Kick 1, Flying Kick 2, All-Around Sight 2, Backward Kick 3 example; a higher maneuver learned only when those beneath it are learned. THE SELECTION: the 1d8 maneuvers of the principal method or the Training list, the second 1-3 roll from the other methods - the arsenal of tactics; the Training category learnable in any style; the maneuvers gained gradually per Learning Martial Arts. The grid codifies per the R431 calculus
